maria: quick sync — we need to lock down GA slices driven by customer impact. my proposed slices: 1) free/seed embeddings limits (PLG funnel), 2) dedicated burst pool (enterprise perf), 3) private on‑prem pilot (regulated customers). for each slice we need SLA targets, docs owner, support runway, and pricing/quotas. can we call this out today?

alex: +1. for dedicated burst pool i think SLO should be p99 < 350ms for 1–2k concurrent requests (target hw: A100/80GB). free tier embeddings should have a cost-protect fallback (rate limit + cache).

jamal: customers pushing for private pilot want 24/7 support during onboarding and a one-week performance validation window. they also asked for rollback playbook if latency regressions appear during cutover.

sasha: agree on rollback playbook. support runway: recommend 2 weeks full-time SE support for pilot customers, and an oncall buddy for the first month after GA. I'll draft runbook templates.

kevin: pricing angle — for dedicated burst we need a reserved commit + overage model. suggest publish two tiers: "burst-light" and "burst-pro" with different commit levels. also need quota enforcement in billing to prevent runaway usage during burn-in.

alex: rough SLO matrix sketch: ```
- free embeddings: p99 <= 600ms, soft quota 5k requests/day
- dedicated burst (commit): p99 <= 350ms, throughput 500 req/s per pool node
- private pilot (onprem): SLA negotiable, default target p95 <= 500ms, include performance validation period
```

maria: nice. owners: alex -> perf SLO validation + bench scripts, sasha -> support runbook + handoff, kevin -> pricing docs + quota enforcement, jamal -> customer comms + pilot coordination. i'll own the overall acceptance checklist.

jamal: customer comms — i'll prepare a short playbook for expectations and a checklist for what we need from them pre-pilot (sample dataset, peak traffic window, contact points).

ops-bot: reminder: "Launch readiness review" meeting scheduled today 15:00 UTC.

maria: can we agree on acceptance gates? my proposed minimal GA gates per slice: 1) SLO verification on 3 representative traces, 2) docs published (API + runbook), 3) support rota signed up, 4) billing/quota test passed. thumbs if yes. :thumbsup:

alex: :thumbsup: I'll add the perf traces and automation to the bench repo.

sasha: :thumbsup: will add runbook PR and oncall roster.

kevin: :thumbsup: will publish pricing draft and run a quota dry-run.

jamal: +1 — i'll line up the pilot cohort and confirm datasets.

maria: great — action items in the doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/launch/slices/1711118888 (please update). meeting in 15. thanks everyone.
